notes.title: OneShot: World Machine Edition Coming to Steam!
notes.content:
One Shot: World Machine Edition, a completely reimagined and expanded version of the highly-rated puzzle adventure game, is coming to Steam on September 30, and [b]owners of the original version[/b] on Steam can pick it up for [b]50% off[/b] during Launch Week! 

KOMODO and Future Cat have teamed up to deliver a fully upgraded and expanded version of OneShot, built on an entirely new engine with enhanced graphics, new UI, support for more platforms, and more. 

So once again peer into the world of OneShot, this time through a strange new operating system. Relive the journey with Niko on Steam Deck, and work to rekindle the long dead sun and – hopefully – save everyone. Wishlist Today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2915460/OneShot_World_Machine_Edition/

[h2]New For World Machine Edition[/h2]

[list]
[*] Character Profile "Friends" Gallery, with bonus writing by Noxid
[*] Cutscene Art Gallery
[*] Colorful wallpapers for the World Machine desktop, featuring many guest artists
[*] Music Box
[*] Full Analog Movement Control support
[*] Support for Steam Deck
[/list]

notes.title: Margin of the Strange: Future Cat's next game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12709963/ed57978b2231be5adad5b4825fc4b610b054b99a.png[/img]

Margin of the Strange is a gardening-themed mystery-exploration game about the world of human dreams. You play as Ling, a young man experiencing the phenomenon of "dreaming" for seemingly the first time. He discovers that the dream world is actually a type of ecosystem -- a sprawling, crystalline, alien dimension dictated by Strange physical laws. Over the course of 6 weeks, Ling seeks to find out more about this world in order to unravel the mysteries surrounding his own life... and his own death.

Teaser Trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J98fBInCuaU

Kickstarter:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/futurecatgames/margin-of-the-strange

Website:
https://marginofthestrange.com/

* Steam page for "Margin of the Strange" will be up at a later date.

notes.title: Virgo VS The Zodiac at BitSummit 7 Spirits this weekend!
notes.content:
A big hello to all the Degica fans out there!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33661629/7047f9a1426919c77856fd8e95014b89e8176c8b.jpg[/img]

We here at Degica Games are proud to announce our publishing partnership with Moonana the team behind the unforgiving timed action turn-based JRPG Virgo Vs The Zodiac! (VVTZ for short!)

Get ready to "Embark on a cosmic quest to follow your fate, or defy your destiny" this Autumn 2019.

Along with the news of our publishing partnership, Degica and Moonana will be attending Japan's largest Indie Game event, [url=https://bitsummit.org/en/][b]BitSummit 7 Spirits[/b][/url], from June 1st & 2nd at Miyako Messe in Kyoto. If you are in Kyoto come on by and check out the special Virgo Vs The Zodiac demo we will have on display and meet the Moonana team!

[h1]About Virgo VS The Zodiac:[/h1]
[b]Virgo Vs The Zodiac is a sci-fi/fantasy JRPG inspired by the Mario & Luigi RPG series and the Mother RPG series[/b] in which you play as an obsessed villain. The game features traditional turn-based combat with real-time execution of moves: blocking, countering and timing your attacks carefully as well as predicting your foes' moves is essential to succeed in [b]Virgo's twisted and unforgiving cosmic quest to bring back the Golden Age[/b], a period of peace, symmetry and balance, or so she thinks. In this galaxy where every action means a reaction, you’ll play as Virgo, the Holy Queen, often called Dreadful Queen by heretics, bringing mayhem to the Zodiac Realms and leaving a trail of stardust on the way, all to fit her excessively righteous worldview. 

[h1]Special Origins Interview:[/h1]
You can also get a glimpse into the beginnings of the game and how it came to be in this special interview article with the creator Nana.

http://blog.rpgmakerweb.com/interview/virgo-vs-the-zodiac/

[h1]BitSummit 7 Spirits[/h1]
Those who attend the event will be able to try out the exciting battle demo in either English or Japanese!
Attendees who have tried the demo will receive a random acrylic keychain of a character from Virgo Vs The Zodiac! 

For those who come to see us at our booth, we will be also handing out Steam keys for the BitSummit demo version, along with an original designed clear file! 
Supplies are limited so be sure to stop by!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33661629/7fc0cfd37e8fea1c5b946f78ccbc986c997541a7.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33661629/01d7ba0480edf3f01a920ae04a502f8d75b11bc0.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Event Info[/h1]
We will be attending as "Degica Games"
Event Name：BitSummit 7 Spirits
Date：June 1st - June 2nd, 2019 
Time：10:00 ～ 17:00 
Venue：Kyoto International Exhibition Hall: MIYAKO MESSE 3rd Exhibition Hall, 3rd Floor
Organizer：BitSummit Organization Committee
[url=http://bitsummit.org/ ]BitSummit Homepage[/url]
We will announce our booth information on the[url=https://twitter.com/degicagames]DegicaGames Official[/url] Twitter account so give us a follow and stay tuned!

notes.title: OneShot - Japanese is Now Available!
notes.content:
Japanese localization is finally available for OneShot!

[h1]Niko celebrates Japanese release[/h1]
Here is a cute Niko illustration and message from [b]Nightmargin[/b] specially drawn for the Japanese release!  Niko is super excited to meet new Japanese friends (...and eat pancakes, too!)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12709963/bc0573a06abdc55d4a6e1fe5573148c516b83adf.png[/img]

[h1]→ For those who play for the first time[/h1]
Launch the game and you can select Japanese from the main menu.
[Main Menu] > [Settings] > [Language]

[h1]→For those who want to restart the whole game[/h1]
If you are in the middle of the game already, and also want to restart the whole game from beginning in Japanese, you can restart the whole journey by the process below: 

[spoiler]You can erase OneShot's save data completely here:
[b]C:\Users\(User)\AppData\Roaming\Oneshot[/b]
* (User) should be the name you set on your own PC
* Please make sure to turn off Steam cloud save before this process
Erasing all of the data in this folder allows you to restart the game from the beginning.
[/spoiler]

If you encounter any issue through Japanese play, please report it here
https://steamcommunity.com/app/420530/discussions/1/1474222595290262015/

We're working hard on other languages too.
Thank you for your support, and please stay tuned!

notes.title: Sign up for the OneShot Localization Beta
notes.content:
Attention international fans! I'm very excited to announce that we're finally nearing the end of the localization process! All 50k+ words have been translated into 6 different languages and all text, documents, and images have been integrated into the game. Now we humbly ask for your help!

Next week, we'll be running a closed beta to help assure the quality of the translations. We're looking for a few bilingual fans to run through the game and report any errors they find. If you're interested in participating in the beta, please read the details below and fill out the sign-up form. We'll be in contact if you qualify with more details.

[h1]Beta Details[/h1]
Beta will start [i]Monday, July 24th[/i] and end [i]Monday, July 31st[/i]!

[b]Sign-up Form[/b]
If you are fluent in one or more of the following languages, [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScJgHCHoJIE4WEAvzRxkZhOF8NVoyDDi1M5WFs_Bep_BpvlxQ/viewform?usp=sf_link]please click here to sign-up![/url]

[b]Languages[/b][list]
[*]Korean
[*]Japanese
[*]Chinese (Simplified)
[*]French
[*]Spanish
[*]Portuguese (Brazil)[/list]

Thanks again everyone for your patience with the localization! We'll have news on release dates very soon.

notes.title: Settings & Colorblind mode patch
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12709963/d8052c7ab3d4b94c396a7c3e20ebdf9d85e6867b.png[/img]

The game finally has a settings menu!  I'll explain what these settings do below:
-BGM volume:  lets you alter the in-game volume of background music and music effects (item pickup jingles)
-SFX volume:  lets you alter the in-game volume of sound effects
-Fullscreen:  lets you toggle fullscreen on and off (this can still be done with the F8 key)
-Default Movement:  lets you set either RUN or WALK to be the default movement for Niko, and holding the Shift key lets you use the other movement type
-Colorblind Mode:  lets you toggle colorblind mode.  When activated, 2 puzzles are modified slightly to be easier for colorblind players to solve
-Frameskip:  lets you toggle frameskip off and on.  If you are having issues where the game is dropping too many frames/seems too laggy, you will probably want to turn frameskip off
-Configure Controls:  doesn't actually do anything, just here to remind you that you can rebind the controls with the F1 key

Other changes that are in this patch:
-Game should no longer crash for some users when minimized or hidden
-Niko will now mention gas events are too tall if using bottle of pond water
-Can no longer save in final elevator (to prevent softlocking the game here), instead game autosaves right before and right after
-Can no longer get trapped by fisherman npc in glen
-Game will retry to put "important files" where they need to go when relaunching game near the end, which should fix issue of users not being able to find said files where they're supposed to be
-Minor map fixes
-Minor dialogue fixes
-Disabled opening both menus simultaneously when walking
-Handled error that occurs if you have the journal open when the game tries to copy it
-Put in condition to prevent "Niko is uneasy" infinite loop bug

-minor tile issues in the cliffs and the forest map
-fixed map transition on "start point" map
-fixed animation issues with lamplighter if you did a very specific set of actions
-can no longer open inventory and fast travel at the same time from the Menu
-fixed the bug when using fast travel on the observation deck

If you find any more bugs, please report them here in the bugs subforum, as we're still working on fixing all of them: http://steamcommunity.com/app/420530/discussions/1/

notes.title: Quick fix
notes.content:
Fixed the bug with Kip where Kip wouldn't talk to you if you did a sequence of events in a specific order, making it unable to progress the game (only 1 map file changed for this fix).

Also, we may have found a solution for the Windows 7 crash in the end-game, we'll be testing this more today and tomorrow and could have the fix out sometime tomorrow.
